name: Local Grove Live Rosin Disposable | Perle Di Sole
description:
Genetics: TMZ × Orange Mintz 

Breeder: Bloom Seed Co 

Selected by:Bloom Seed Co 

Aroma & Flavor:Rich gas layered with sweet candy and creamy citrus undertones 

Effects: Strong — fast-hitting and euphoric with a smooth, relaxing body finish 

Perle Di Sole blends the potency of TMZ with the smooth, candy-cream terpene profile of Orange Mintz. The aroma opens with deep gas before transitioning into sweet candy and subtle citrus notes. Effects are strong and immediate, delivering a euphoric head high that gradually settles into calm, balanced relaxation.
